evals.name: blog-traffic-strategy
evals.prompt: Pinterest strategy for my vegan baking blog (veganovenlove.com, 180 recipes). Business account, site not claimed. 23 boards like 'Yummy', 'Faves', 'Stuff to try'. I pin about 2x a week, mostly re-saving my old pins. Analytics: 14k monthly impressions, 210 saves, 95 outbound clicks. Goal: traffic and email signups for my cookbook.
evals.expected_output: Audit in the skill's format: claim site + Rich Pins first, consolidate boards into 8–15 keyword boards with descriptions and sections, keyword list grouped by board (sources named), fresh-pin cadence 1–3/day from the recipe library with 3+ designs per recipe, seasonal calendar, outbound clicks as KPI.
assertions: Recommends claiming the website and enabling Rich Pins as a first step
Replaces vague boards with 8–15 keyword-titled boards with descriptions and sections
Provides a keyword list grouped by board and names the keyword sources (Pinterest search, Trends)
Sets a fresh-pin cadence of roughly 1–3 new pins/day rather than volume re-saving, with multiple designs per recipe
Uses outbound clicks and email signups as KPIs, not followers

evals.name: is-pinterest-worth-it
evals.prompt: We're a B2B payroll software company. Our agency says we should post 20 pins a day on Pinterest to grow. Does that make sense?
evals.expected_output: Honest niche-fit assessment (B2B payroll is a weak fit; some HR/small-business educational content can work modestly), rejects 20 pins/day as outdated volume spam, proposes a small test with realistic KPIs or recommends focusing elsewhere.
assertions: Assesses niche fit honestly — planning-intent audience vs B2B payroll — and sets modest expectations
Explains that 20 pins/day is outdated and penalised; fresh quality pins at 1–5/day are the current norm
Offers a bounded test plan with KPIs (outbound clicks, signups) or a clear recommendation to deprioritise
Does not invent impression or traffic forecasts

evals.name: pin-copy-for-product
evals.prompt: Write Pinterest pin titles and descriptions for our linen bedding (3 colours, €189 queen set, OEKO-TEX certified, free EU shipping). Also tell me which boards they should go on and the pin design specs.
evals.expected_output: Several pin title options ≤100 characters with the keyword first, descriptions ≤500 characters with keywords, benefit and CTA, suggested keyword boards, 2:3 1000×1500 design specs with text overlay guidance, and a note on multiple designs per product URL.
assertions: Titles are ≤100 characters with the main keyword near the start; descriptions are 2–3 sentences with a call to action
Specifies 2:3 ratio / 1000×1500 px, text overlay 3–6 words, brand consistency
Suggests keyword-named boards (e.g. 'Linen Bedding Ideas', 'Bedroom Decor') rather than brand-named boards
Uses the given facts (OEKO-TEX, free EU shipping, €189) without inventing reviews
